premises.text: Catalog front pages show only a tiny sliver of content, so discovery remains a pharmaceutical-grade pain point
premises.evidence_span: When you go to the front page of iTunes, you see a tiny, minuscule sliver of their catalog

premises.text: Behavioral account-level data plus 4–6 trusted social signals (super trust) fuel collaborative filtering better than model tweaks
premises.evidence_span: for any product category, there's four to six people that I truly trust. And that list is steroids for collaborative filtering

premises.text: Product combines social actions as implicit recommendations, object-level similarity, wider consensus, and trusted critics, then lets users buy by price/access
premises.evidence_span: It's a social action as an implicit recommendation, instant gratification, it's object level similarity based on what you actually listen to

premises.text: Sharing to social media exposes non-users to affiliate links; core ARPU comes from affiliate conversions across categories
premises.evidence_span: when non-users see those items in social media, they're being exposed to an affiliate link, and we are effectively monetizing non-users

domains.name: Affiliate monetization of users and non-users

value.text: Help people find the media they actually want through true social discovery
value.evidence_span: true social discovery for media content

secondary_value.text: Build a portable taste graph valuable to media and brand marketers
secondary_value.evidence_span: We're creating a depersonalized taste graph, which would be extremely valuable to media and brand marketers

causal_links.evidence_span: we think there's a better way to find what you want in iTunes
all this fuels what we believe to be the ultimate recommendation
affiliate sales is our core revenue stream

notes: Taste-graph licensing recorded as secondary value aspiration tied to commercial path. Device expansion vision not coded. 'Data startup with multiple viable revenue streams' used to justify keeping monetization as its own domain.
